manual.sporecannons.whiteout.title: WHITEOUT PROTOCOL · FIELD RECORD
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_1:
WHITEOUT-04
FIELD MANUAL

CDU DIVISION
Cryogenic Decontamination Unit

Contain · Freeze · Reclaim
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_2:
CDU ORIGIN

The infection adapts to heat, trauma and hunger. It does not adapt quickly enough to a stopped metabolism. Create machinery made the treatment repeatable; CBC made it deliverable.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_3:
PAYLOADS I–III

I: precision field remedy.
II: local outbreak containment.
III: hardened nests and sealed facilities.

All require a compatible CBC fuze.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_4:
PAYLOADS IV–V

IV: fortification-scale containment.
V: strategic WHITEOUT deployment.

Evacuate the perimeter before authorization is requested.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_5:
CDU-VI
ABSOLUTE ZERO

Authorization was never granted.

Assembly continued regardless.

Even the server tried to object.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_6:
FIELD SCANNER

Surveys infection and parasite signatures at 32, 64 or 128 blocks. Active terminals also receive remote activation warnings and decontamination reports.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_7:
FUZES

The Cryogenic Sensor Fuze selects parasites, infection or both. WHITE WATCH arms a placed shell as a ground mine and ignores players as triggers—not as blast targets.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_8:
COOLANT CARTRIDGES

Pressure vessels are reusable. At 32 RPM a full cartridge powers the field for one hour. Partial charge is retained when removed by hand.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_9:
REFUELING STATION

Insert depleted vessel, water and cryogel. Drive the lower coupling at no less than 32 RPM. Retrieve the sealed cartridge by hand.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_10:
CONTAINMENT PROJECTOR

The field blocks parasites and suppresses biology. Cleaning may be disabled for barrier-only duty. Automation extracts only depleted cartridges.
manual.sporecannons.whiteout.page_11:
POST WHITEOUT-04

Outer sensor line failed. Service crew did not return. Archive transferred to cabinet A.

If the field is still blue, the post is still doing its job.

manual.sporecannons.cryogel.title: PROJECT CRYOGEL · RESEARCH LOG
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_1:
PROJECT CRYOGEL
RESEARCH LOG

WHITEOUT R&D DIVISION
Lead: A. V. Kramer
Recovered copy
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_2:
PROJECT ORDER 17-C
A. V. KRAMER

The infection survives flame, trauma and hunger. We need a cold medium that can be stored, pumped and loaded into CBC ordnance.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_3:
FIELD RECOVERY
R. K. SOKOLOV

We fueled a Spore C.D.U. with an Ice Canister and deployed it beside living biomass. The treated growth became freezerburned.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_4:
RECOVERY NOTE

Harvest treated blocks intact. Six samples are required for each reagent trial.

Do not burn the site. We need what the C.D.U. leaves behind.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_5:
BIOLOGICAL SECTION
M. I. VALE

Frozen tissue collapses when warmed. Mutated fiber, a living core, nerves and a mutated heart produced a symbiotic binding agent.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_6:
FORMULA C-6
A. V. KRAMER

6 freezerburned biomass
2 Ice Canisters
1 Symbiotic Reagent

Result: Cryogenic Reagent. Stable only briefly.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_7:
INDUSTRIAL SECTION
E. T. HOLT

Create's mixer held the process steady. Add Cryogenic Reagent, one Ice Canister, one Frozen Tumor and two snowballs.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_8:
STABLE BATCH 04

Yield: 4 Stabilized Cryogel.

No separation after storage. No rupture under pressure.

Kramer finally slept.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_9:
BALLISTICS SECTION
L. A. BERG

Cryogel compacts into microcells and thermal lining. CBC delivery trials succeeded.

The barrel survived. The window did not.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_10:
SUPPLY DIRECTIVE
V. N. KELLER

Use cryogel in CDU cores, Projectors and coolant cartridges. Refueling stations combine it with water for sustained field duty.
manual.sporecannons.cryogel.page_11:
FINAL ENTRY
A. V. KRAMER

If supply has failed, rebuild the cold chain. The infection brought every material required for its own containment.

Contain · Freeze · Reclaim

sporecannons.ponder.cdu_refueling_statio: Use the two-slot interface: cryogel above, depleted cartridge in the lower interface slot. Supply water by bucket or through the front pipe port.
At 32 RPM charging takes eight seconds. Higher speed smoothly shortens the cycle, up to 3x at 256 RPM.
Automation supplies cryogel from above and handles cartridges through the left or right service bay. The underside remains reserved for the shaft.
sporecannons.ponder.cryogenic_containmen: Insert a charged cartridge and drive the lower shaft at no less than 32 RPM.
From 32 to 256 RPM its radius scales from 12 to 64 blocks. Maximum coverage demands 48 stress impact and consumes coolant at 4× rate.
At 32 RPM one cartridge lasts one real hour. Its charge bar is retained when the cartridge is removed by hand.
Automation inserts charged cartridges from above. Horizontal sides expose a cartridge only after it is fully depleted.
sporecannons.ponder.coolant_automation.t: Feed water through the front fluid pipe and cryogel from above. Both machines need at least 32 RPM from below.
A filtered Funnel, Belt or Mechanical Arm returns a depleted cartridge to a left or right Refuelling Station bay.
When charging completes, the same side port exposes a charged cartridge. Route it into the top of the Projector.
When exhausted, the cartridge becomes available on any horizontal Projector side. Filter it back to the Station to close the loop.
The machines only expose inputs and outputs. The layout is yours: use filters to keep charged and depleted cartridges on the correct routes.

archive.sporecannons.memory_card_logisti: E. T. HOLT // Route Six is lost. The final coolant convoy reached the laboratory with three crates missing. Inventory discrepancy was marked weather damage. Nobody believed it.
archive.sporecannons.memory_card_contain: M. I. VALE // The first field lattice pushed living biomass outside its boundary. Frost fractures appeared in the west wall after 41 minutes. Containment succeeded. The room did not.
archive.sporecannons.memory_card_personn: A. V. KRAMER // Night staff report knocking from Chamber 3 after shutdown. Thermal sensors show zero. Security calls it pipe contraction. The pipes are in the east wing.
archive.sporecannons.memory_card_inciden: 03:14 // Coolant pressure collapsed. Specimen C-6 changed position after its thermal signature reached zero. Archive footage ends eleven seconds before the alarm.
archive.sporecannons.memory_card_directi: If containment fails: seal the wing, recover all data, destroy exposed samples. Personnel retrieval is not authorized after a WHITEOUT declaration.

WHITEOUT REGIONAL CONTROL // ORDER RCS-04

Relay posts 04, 09 and 12 will report through this station. Personnel convoys will follow marked northern coordinates until further notice.
Orbital Network timing remains unavailable. Continue ground synchronization every six hours. Do not delay a containment response while waiting for orbital confirmation.

Posts 09 and 12 have missed two reports. Their remaining crews are reassigned to Regional Control. Bunks in the east wing are cleared for eighteen arrivals.
